format: Vanilla 26.3 structure starts. worlds[i]: dimension, seed, min_y, height, origin (ChunkGeneratorStructureState.getDimensionOrigin), area [min_chunk_x, min_chunk_z, size_x, size_z], stronghold_rings (getRingPositionsFor of the stronghold placement, all positions, null if none), chunks (targeted chunks). For every chunk of the area (z outer, x inner) and then every targeted chunk, ChunkGenerator.createStructures ran on a fresh ProtoChunk (state = generator.createState(structure sets in registry order, randomState, seed) after ensureStructuresGenerated). starts: every start of those chunks in that chunk order, per chunk sorted by structure id; one per line: {w: world index, structure, chunk: [x, z], references, bb: [min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z] (StructureStart.getBoundingBox), pieces: [[piece type id, bb, orientation (direction name or null), gen_depth, rotation, mirror (StructurePiece.getRotation/getMirror, enum constant names such as CLOCKWISE_90 and LEFT_RIGHT: the placement settings of template pieces, the jigsaw rotation of pool element pieces, else derived from the orientation; null without orientation), data]]} in StructureStart.getPieces order. data is the piece's NBT (StructurePiece.createTag) without id, BB, O and GD, keys sorted, numbers as JSON numbers (e.g. Template/TPX/TPY/TPZ of template pieces; pool_element {element_type, location, processors, projection}, PosX/PosY/PosZ, rotation, ground_level_delta, junctions of jigsaw pieces). A chunk of the area or targeted list without entry has no start.
